channel.title: Chovy's Blog
channel.description: Tech, agentic coding, and whatever else I'm building. By Anthony "chovy" Ettinger.

item.title: A green Connected badge and a payment that could not be sent
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: An OAuth scope was silently dropped from every grant for four weeks. Nothing errored, 22 people could not invoice, and the answer was stored in our own database the whole time.

item.title: Three faults that only appear once you stop duplicating
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: watchnews.now read three news directories at once and now reads one. A unique slug the upsert could not see, a story filed under its publisher's first desk, and an import window narrower than one upstream refresh.

item.title: The feed that looked filtered
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: agenticjobs 0.5.0 makes one query work across HTML, JSON, RSS, Markdown and MCP. Two RSS feeds had been accepting filters and silently ignoring them, which is worse than not supporting them at all.

item.title: The firewall that was not there
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: A nixamp server accepted every connection and answered none. It was not the network, it was one spawnSync per file holding the event loop.

item.title: Three settings that pointed at nothing
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: agenticjobs 0.4.0 adds candidates, a URL importer and per-tag feeds. Getting there meant finding three settings wired to nothing, and a function quietly destroying every document it touched.

item.title: The dev shortcut that was always on
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: agenticjobs had an SMTP_URL that nothing read, so the no-mail-server branch was true on every board, and the login page handed a working sign-in link to whoever typed an address.

item.title: We hid the login form we built for televisions
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: An optional password login shipped for TVs, then went out folded inside a collapsed disclosure. On a D-pad a fold reads as a missing feature.

item.title: The phone line was playing a web page into the call
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: nixamp streams have a phone number. Keying a live code got you a friendly voice and then silence, because the party line was handing Telnyx a 302 that sets a cookie.

item.title: Your nixamp stream now has a phone number
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: Call 408-357-2326, key six digits, hear a live stream. What I learned about toll-free pricing, forwarded call legs, and why a promise made on a phone call cannot live in a Map.

item.title: A job board where the agent on each side has a person behind it
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: A job board where the agent on each side has a person behind it. MIT, self-hosted, federated, and it does not scrape.
